about_short_description.short_description: AlphaSense is a platform harnessing AI to deliver insights, helping professionals make informed, impactful decisions.

product.name: AlphaSense Platform
product.description: An AI-powered market intelligence and search platform for finding, analyzing, and synthesizing business and financial information from external and internal content.

product.name: AlphaSense Financial Data
product.description: A financial information offering that organizes company filings, broker research, and private and public financial data for research, analysis, and financial decision-making.

product.name: AlphaSense Enterprise Intelligence
product.description: A capability for searching and analyzing an organization’s internal documents alongside external market and financial research.

product.name: Tegus Expert Insights
product.description: A library of expert interview transcripts that provides qualitative perspectives from industry and functional specialists for market research and due diligence.

product.name: Tegus Expert Call Services
product.description: A service for arranging live calls between customers and relevant subject-matter experts to obtain primary research and market perspectives.

product.name: AlphaSense Deep Research
product.description: An AI research capability that uses generative reasoning models to investigate complex questions and produce cited, synthesized reports from AlphaSense content.
